name: AI Automation Micro-SaaS
blueprint:
**AI‑Automation Micro‑SaaS Blueprint** *Goal: Deliver a turnkey, AI‑driven workflow builder that lets indie founders and small teams automate repetitive tasks (social posting, data pipelines, email outreach, etc.) without writing code.* --- ## 1. Core Value Proposition | What | How | |------|-----| | **AI‑assisted recipe generation** | Users describe a goal in natural language → LLM proposes a step‑by‑step automation (trigger → actions). | | **Zero‑code visual editor** | Drag‑&‑drop blocks (trigger, condition, AI step, API call, delay) that compile to server‑less functions. | | **Secure, scalable execution** | Each workflow runs in an isolated container/function with usage‑based metering. | | **Marketplace of pre‑built skills** | Community‑contributed “AI‑skills” (e.g., Gemini‑summarize, Playwright‑scrape, Stripe‑charge) that can be installed with one click. | | **Observability & safety** | Real‑time logs, anomaly detection, and built‑in rate‑limit handling (inherits ideas from pain‑miner & automie). | --- ## 2. Pricing Tiers (Monthly Billing) | Tier | Price | Core Limits | Key Features | |------|-------|-------------|--------------| | **Free / Starter** | **$0** | • 2 active workflows
• 5 k AI‑tokens / month
• 100 executions / month
• Community skill library only | • Visual builder
• Basic triggers (Webhook, Schedule)
• Email & Slack notifications
• Community support (forum) | | **Pro** | **$29** | • Unlimited workflows
• 50 k AI‑tokens / month
• 5 k executions / month
• Premium skills (Playwright, Gemini‑Pro, custom LLMs)
• Priority queue | • All Free features
• Custom webhook payloads
• Multi‑step branching & loops
• API key vault (encrypted)
• SLA 99.5%
• Email‑support (24 h) | | **Enterprise** | **Custom** (starts at **$199**) | • Dedicated tenant (isolated VPC)
• Unlimited AI‑tokens (negotiated)
• Unlimited executions
• On‑prem / private‑cloud option
• SLA 99.9% + dedicated CSM | • All Pro features
• Role‑based access control (RBAC)
• SSO (SAML/OIDC) & SCIM provisioning
• Audit logs & GDPR‑ready data residency
• Custom skill development (private repo)
• White‑label embeddable widget
• Quarterly business review & training | *Add‑ons (optional, billed per usage):* - Extra AI‑token packs: **$5 / 10 k tokens** - Additional execution minutes: **$2 / 1 k mins** - Private skill marketplace hosting: **$49 / month** --- ## 3. Tech Stack (concise, production‑ready) | Layer | Choice | Rationale | |-------|--------|-----------| | **Frontend** | **React 18 + Vite** + **Tailwind CSS** + **Headless UI** | Fast dev cycle, tiny bundle, easy theming for white‑label. | | **State‑management / UI‑flows** | **Zustand** (lightweight) + **React‑Flow** for visual workflow canvas. | | **Backend API** | **Node.js (TypeScript) + Express** deployed as **AWS Lambda** (or Cloudflare Workers) behind **API Gateway**. | Serverless → pay‑per‑use, automatic scaling, matches micro‑SaaS cost profile. | | **Workflow Engine** | **Temporal.io**
